**Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd. (SYN‑000286)**  
- **Status & Structure:** Active private limited company incorporated on 20 Nov 2017 in Sabah, operating in the Food & Beverage sector as a wholesale distributor of frozen food to restaurants. Paid‑up share capital RM 500,000.  
- **Ownership & Management:** Two individual shareholders – Director 1 (98.86 %) and Director 2 (1.14 %). The board comprises a Managing Director (appointed 14 Mar 2019), an Executive Director (appointed 3 Aug 2019) and an Independent Director (appointed 7 Dec 2024).  

### Recent Financial Highlights  
| Year | Revenue (RM) | Gross Profit (RM) | Net Profit (RM) | EBITDA (RM) | Total Assets (RM) | Total Equity (RM) |
|------|--------------|-------------------|----------------|------------|-------------------|-------------------|
| 2022 | 4,205,420 | 2,094,592 (49.8 % GP margin) | 173,231 (4.1 % NP margin) | 476,345 (11.3 % EBITDA margin) | 4,537,593 | 1,690,966 |
| 2024 | 4,419,464 | 2,222,961 (50.3 % GP margin) | 178,923 (4.0 % NP margin) | 496,479 (11.2 % EBITDA margin) | 4,768,543 | 1,945,146 |

- **Profitability:** Consistently modest net margins (~4 %) with stable gross margins around 50 %. Operating profit margins hover near 8 %.  
- **Liquidity:** Quick ratio improved from 1.27 (2022) to 1.40 (2024); cash‑to‑revenue fell slightly (8.4 % → 6.9 %). Free cash flow turned negative in 2024 (‑RM 20,288).  
- **Efficiency:** Cash conversion cycle shortened from ~142 days to ~137 days; inventory turnover rose from 3.61 to 4.13 times.  
- **Capital Structure:** Leverage decreased (Debt/Equity ≈ 1.68 → 1.45). Interest coverage remains healthy (>3×).  

### Litigation Snapshot (Sabah Courts)  
- **Active cases:** Two pending winding‑up/tenancy disputes (total claim ≈ RM 466,500).  
- **Recent outcomes:** One debt‑recovery judgment (RM 97,600) and one construction dispute settled (RM 68,900). Earlier employment claim settled (RM 231,100).  

**Overall picture:** Cahaya Seri Catering is a small‑to‑mid‑size, owner‑controlled frozen‑food wholesaler with steady revenue growth, solid gross margins, and manageable debt levels. Profitability is modest and cash generation has weakened recently, while the company faces a handful of legal exposures, the largest being a pending winding‑up petition.
